Name: Bulk Eating and Drinking (No Longer Maintained)
Author: Darkmushu1
Description:
I'm quitting modding to explore other things in life, whoever wants to take over the project and or maintain just let me know and I can add a redirect link here to your Nexus mod page.

[b]What mod Does[/b]
Eat(Any foods) or Drink(Any Drink) in bulk. (Configurable) default sets food to 3, and drinks to 1.  Health and Stamina recovered will add from all consumed items. Example: You eat 3 food, each food gives 30 life and 30 stamina and so you'll recover 90 life and 90 stamina.

[b]Some use case[/b]
Useful early games and in multiplayer where time usually doesn't stop when you eat. Example: Allows you to eat multiple algae or spring onions or drink multiple coffees at a time.

[b]Info on how it affects buffs[/b]
Food buffs and drink buffs duration will be multiplied by the number of food eaten or by number of drinks drank in a single animation, but any separate eat/drink animation will not stack buffs.

Credits for idea for option choice
Was requested by end users to add "eat until full life and stamina" which is an idea from an existing mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3771
and so I added that option choice with existing config options.
